description: This file contains a PHP class definition for managing user data in an OpenCart administrative context, including functions for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting user records, as well as managing user login sessions.

classes.name: User
classes.description: A model class for managing user data within the OpenCart admin module, extending the core engine model, providing CRUD operations and authorization handling.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Inserts a new user record into the database with data provided in an associative array, including username, user group, password, first name, last name, email, image, and status.

methods.name: editUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user's information based on user ID and input data, with optional password update.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Sets a new password for a user identified by user ID.

methods.name: editCode
methods.description: Updates the verification code associated with a user identified by email.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Removes a user record and associated authorization and login data from the database.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves a single user's data, including group name, based on user ID.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Fetches user data for a given username.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Fetches user data for a given email address.

methods.name: getUserByCode
methods.description: Retrieves user data associated with a specific verification code.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Fetches multiple users with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalUsers
methods.description: Returns the total number of users matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByGroupId
methods.description: Returns the count of users within a specific user group.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByEmail
methods.description: Returns the count of users with a specific email (case-insensitive).

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Records a login event for a user, storing IP, user agent, and timestamp.

methods.name: deleteLogins
methods.description: Removes login records for a specific user.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Removes authorization data for a specific user (not fully detailed in provided snippet).

methods.name: deleteLogins
methods.description: Deletes all login records for a specific user based on user ID.

methods.name: getLogins
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of login entries for a user, with start and limit parameters to control the subset.

methods.name: getTotalLogins
methods.description: Returns the total number of login records for a specific user.
